mapper.select: SELECT strategy_id, params_json, version, updated_at, updated_by FROM strategy_param WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_param (strategy_id, params_json, version, updated_by) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{paramsJson}, 0, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE params_json = VALUES(params_json), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
